name: Tears of joy
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, medium 2, mesmerist 1, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature; see text
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You fill the target with such overwhelming joy that they are blinded by tears and staggered. On the creature’s next turn, it may attempt a new saving throw to end the effect. This is a full round action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If this save is successful, the effect ends.

Creatures without eyes and aquatic creatures are not blinded, but they are still staggered. A creature with an Intelligence score of 2 or lower is not affected.
